## What problem does this solve

Describe the friction this addresses. Concrete example beats abstract description.

## Proposed solution

What would the new script / doc section / troubleshooting entry look like? If it's a script, sketch the parameters and expected output.

## Alternatives considered

Did you try anything that almost worked? Why didn't it?

## Scope check

This repo covers Windows-specific setup, helpers, and troubleshooting for connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop. Confirm your request fits:

- [ ] This is a Windows-specific setup or troubleshooting issue
- [ ] This is **not** a feature request for the upstream MCP server (those go to [tradesdontlie/tradingview-mcp](https://github.com/tradesdontlie/tradingview-mcp))
- [ ] This is **not** a request for macOS/Linux support (out of scope here)
- [ ] This is **not** a generic Claude Code or MCP question

## Additional context

Links to relevant upstream issues, related PowerShell snippets, screenshots if a UI is involved.
